toolArguments.prompt:
Create exactly ONE complete native B07 building sprite, not a sheet. Architecture identity reference: B07-appearance.png ONLY; ignore the crop camera, roads, trees and neighboring buildings. 约三层U形围院住宅，左右两翼与后部围合，平屋顶、重复独立窗洞、局部凹入开口和暖色竖向墙段；不是连续玻璃办公幕墙。
Geometry: fixed orthographic source-road camera elevation 62.5 deg / azimuth 45 deg. Frontage screen -28.486362689 deg, depth +55.405984491 deg, walls screen-vertical. Not generic 30-degree isometric. Preserve chirality, no mirror/rotation/shear. Candidate envelope {'frontage': 18, 'depth': 12, 'height': 10}, production candidates only. Preserve U-shaped three-storey massing with open recessed courtyard facing road, substantial walls and discrete domestic window openings. Do not fill courtyard with a box or turn walls into glazed curtain wall. Do not invent large projecting balconies from this tiny source. Neutral-daylight thick-painted Japanese/anime contemporary urban style from original user reference, restrained clear edges; accepted buildings only qualitative light/finish reference. Soft upper-left daylight, restrained neutral shadows. Whole building and all feet inside frame with safe margin. True transparent RGBA background. No broad ground shadow, roads, sidewalk, ground patch, trees, rooftop trees, people, vehicles, text, logos, labels or guide marks. No yellow wash, global blue tint or glowing windows. Native requested 1536x1536; actual dimensions/alpha must be measured. Runtime derivative max edge 280. Never enlarge crop as native art. Source occlusions must not become attached trees or neighboring buildings. Exactly one output.

Reference roles in order: geometry proxy ONLY camera/footprint and U shaped mass, appearance crop ONLY identity, original user reference ONLY painted style. DO NOT inherit B01 shop glass: B07 needs domestic discrete windows, substantial wall piers, warm vertical wall panels as crop. Only building/necessary tiny entry steps. Entire open U COURTYARD MUST BE TRUE TRANSPARENT EMPTY SPACE THROUGH TO BACKGROUND; no grass, paving, slab, courtyard floor or plants. Keep U opening; never fill it into a solid box. Geometry guide text and proxy colors must not appear.

sourceSelection.boxConvention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; full building envelope plus context, not alpha segmentation
sourceSelection.identity: 约三层U形围院住宅，左右两翼与后部围合，平屋顶、重复独立窗洞、局部凹入开口和暖色竖向墙段；不是连续玻璃办公幕墙。
sourceSelection.limitations: 源地脚被院内树木及前景坡顶住宅局部遮挡；阳台细节不够清楚，不声称存在明确外挑阳台。
sourceSelection.dimensionStatus: PM shape candidates, not source measurements or user hard limits
sourceSelection.selectionReason: 约三层U形围院住宅，左右两翼与后部围合，平屋顶、重复独立窗洞、局部凹入开口和暖色竖向墙段；不是连续玻璃办公幕墙。

courtyardSample.note: single empty courtyard sample plus visual inspection, not exhaustive segmentation

visualInspection: 已实际打开原生与运行PNG；主体完整，留有透明边，墙竖边目视屏幕竖直。
少量原生白色轮廓碎边/游离alpha碎点，未修原生像素；运行缩小后窗细节软化。
底边目视约-28°/+55°，仅估读，不是精确相机或地基标定。
U形开口保留，中庭目视透明，像素(680,850) alpha=0；无草坪/道路/树木/庭院底板。
三层独立窗洞和暖色竖向墙段，区别B03连续玻璃办公；屋顶设备较多。
